notes.title: ALL LANGUAGES ARE HERE!
notes.notes:
Hi, there!

Just a quick update.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35274891/17c5bcf1afc122d56a913176ad4040f7846a64c9.jpg[/img]

If you're German, Russian or Portuguese, you can now play the game in your mother language. If you have any feedback on the translation or the game, you can leave it here or in our discord server:

[url=https://discord.gg/thepsychiartist]The Psychiartist Official[/url]

notes.title: ITALIAN IS HERE!
notes.notes:
[b]Hello there! I just updated the game!
[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35274891/067b31d4bf3bfb0f619ffd7a57dc78c65c30b416.png[/img]

[i][b]Peace![/b][/i]

notes.title: TOMORROW IS THE BIG DAY!
notes.notes:
Hello, world!

Round Rooms will launch tomorrow with six languages (English, Arabic, French, Lithuanian, Spanish and Turkish.)  More languages will be added in future updates as shown in the image.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35274891/e4bb81654b9f79d4be2ff11056e6bf47084a757b.png[/img]

Have a good one!
